summary: Exception handling advice: validate up front, keep the design simple and defensive, fail predictably, include context in messages, and avoid catch-all exceptions.
questions: How should modules handle unexpected errors?
Should I catch all exceptions in my module?

answer_card.title: Handle exceptions gracefully
answer_card.answer_md:
- Validate early and fail fast with clear messages.
- Keep the design simple and avoid stack traces.
- Fail predictably, mimicking the underlying tool.
- Say what you were doing and include the exception message.
- Avoid catch-all exceptions unless the API gives good errors.
